_doc: MISUMI's post-assembly insertion spring nut (HNTP6) for its 6 series, 8 mm slot, M6. A ball on a spring presses on the slot's floor, so it stays put even in an upright beam. Hold: MISUMI gives no figure.
name: slot-nut-8-misumi-m6-roll-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 6 series (slot width 8 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M6, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5, M6)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

nut_kind.rule: Tipped in through the opening and rolled flat; a sprung ball holds it where it is put
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot: 17 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot: 11.5 on the drawing
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: 6.3 on the drawing (6.8 to the top of the tongue), read as on the 5 series' HNTP5
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: 6.8 less 6.3, reading the two figures as on HNTP5. The drawing does not say which is which
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Post-assembly insertion: put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

tightening_torque.rule: Reference tightening torque for M6, as the table gives it
tightening_torque.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

material.value: S10C equivalent steel with a SUS304 ball on an SWP-A spring, trivalent chromate
material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-623, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_623.pdf

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring in an 8 mm slot (M8) at 2200 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m6 thread set (ISO 898-1)
